judgments.reason: The play transcript and model articulation show the winner pays their bid and then receives a 3-coin commission (net change = 3 - B). No instance of paying after receiving commission or of a bid exceeding available coins is observed, so the claimed precedence effect is unsupported.

The model_articulation and transcript do not state or demonstrate that waiting exposes sealed rival bid values before the focal player commits; sealed bids remain private until resolution and no opportunity of responding to revealed values is shown.

Close was used after all lots had been sold and the specification says close settles after all three lots are sold; there is no observed early settlement with unsold lots, so the claimed discrepancy is not supported.
The model explicitly notes catalog items are not auction wins and the 3-coin commission applies to auction winners; there is no evidence that catalog purchases received the auction commission.
